description: This Java class provides a default implementation of configuration handling for Akka's distributed data replicator within the Eclipse Ditto service utilities. It reads configuration settings, offers factory methods for creating instances, and implements equality and string representation methods.

classes.name: DefaultAkkaReplicatorConfig
classes.description: A class implementing AkkaReplicatorConfig that encapsulates configuration for Akka's distributed data replicator, allowing creation from configuration sources, and providing access to configuration details.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance based on a Config object, with fallback configuration.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance using specific name and role parameters along with a Config object.

methods.name: getRole
methods.description: Returns the cluster role associated with the replicator.

methods.name: getCompleteConfig
methods.description: Returns the complete Config object used internally.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another DefaultAkkaReplicatorConfig object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code based on config, name, and role.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the configuration.
